note.windows: The build takes about 5 minutes and 1 GB. Python and the Visual Studio Build Tools are installed if they are missing; the Build Tools are about 3 GB and add 15 to 30 minutes, and Windows asks for permission once.
note.linux: The build takes about 10 minutes and 2 GB, and the game is played under Wine. It needs clang, lld, llvm, cmake, ninja, Wine (with 32-bit support) and Python 3 from your package manager; if any are missing it says which, with the command to install them. It downloads xwin and, through it, Microsoft's C runtime and Windows SDK (about 1 GB, under Microsoft's licence).
